generationPrompts.initial: Create the final arcade historical battlefield artwork using FIRST image as exact authoritative gameplay geometry, SECOND image ONLY as material/painting style reference, NOT its composition. Landscape fills a wide 1672x941 canvas. Yamanaka Castle assault, 1590 spring: Toyotomi attackers' THREE small low outer liaison positions on LEFT at blue dots (.13,.53),(.13,.69),(.13,.85); use low blue pennants and compact supply tents to the LEFT of each dot leaving dot ground clear, never big friendly gates. Hostile HOJO earthen mountain fort at upper-right brown rectangle (.69,.11); modest wooden palisade, unpainted watch hut, reddish opposing pennants. Enemy owns HIGH upper-right ridge, friendly positions own LOW western footslope. Overall landform is a broad DIAGONAL descending ridge from upper-right to lower-left, visibly stepped irregular red-loam hillsides and natural wooded ravines, no huge round island in the center. Three light-beige corridors must become real wide dirt military approach routes AT EXACT SAME screen coordinates and widths as guide: upper ridge track, middle sloping contour traverse, lower dry-moat outer access. Round only tiny corners naturally without shifting the route corridor. They are three separated fronts with no added connecting roads, no loops, no merged common goal. Red dots are hostile approach points; remove all guide dots/labels/ellipses in final. Light green ovals MUST remain flat open grass/earth pockets for standing units, no rocks, trees, cliffs, roofs or poles over them. Brown middle rectangle (.49,.475) is ridged dry earthen moat, brown lower rectangle (.44,.72) is several irregular GRID COMPARTMENTS of deep exposed red-earth shojibori, NOT water/paddy; keep these off roads and off light-green pockets. Native terrain is earth-and-wood Japanese hill castle, NO stone castle/no temple/no giant keep. Natural deciduous forest, a few prominent pink spring cherry trees along outer edges, broken roots and scarred earth from assault; do not hide battlefield with foliage. Rich appealing sculpted/painted arcade 3D, matched second-image quality but new composition, camera oblique42degrees looking toward high upper-right across slopes. Show height changes with visible soil banks not fake painted road shadows. Keep whole map readable, natural grass and clear fighting spaces. No people, numbers, text, UI, colored guide marks, or separate raid tracks.

generationPrompts.initial: Render a NEW final historical arcade battlefield. FIRST image is the authoritative 1672x941 geometry guide: preserve beige road corridors, endpoints and fork junctions EXACTLY in screen space. SECOND image is ONLY material/texture/style reference; discard its central fort/U-shaped composition completely. Setting: siege perimeter OUTSIDE Odawara's Sogamae, summer1590, Toyotomi besiegers LEFT, Hojo defenders on the RIGHT. Layout: two enemy sortie entrances on the right, upper at(.88,.12) and lower at(.98,.64). EACH entrance has one short shared road before dividing into two. FOUR different friendly contact floors are blue dots (.16,.36),(.25,.52),(.34,.70),(.42,.84), arranged as a DIAGONALLY STAGGERED LINE from HIGH wooded northwest slope to LOW southern ground. They MUST NOT converge to one base. Tiny friendly blue supply posts to LEFT of each contact, leave each blue-dot floor free for soldiers, not giant gates. All red/blue dots and green ovals are guide marks: remove them in final. Every light-green ellipse must become a CLEAR flat open ground pocket with standing-unit headroom, no props over it. Tall northwest ridge with visible natural earth banks occupies upperLEFT; main friendly high post is on its shoulder, next post slightly lower, last two are on low ground. Enemy lower-right bank is modestly higher than the bottom friendly post. A broad diagonal changing-altitude battlefront, NOT a row of four parallel flat highways. Height creates the variety: upper pair climbs friendly hill, lower pair follows the outside of moats at low elevation. Roads remain wide traversable ramps without excessive snake curves. Brown rectangles: SHORT genuine earthen rampart ends and dry ditches, low palisades; biggest rectangle at(.83,.41) has a few period wooden town roofs near its upper/right portion, leaving the light-green pocket in its lowerLEFT corner entirely open as outer courtyard outside the palisade. These Hojo fortifications use subdued red pennants. Blue WATER rectangles become short narrow water moats with natural irregular shores INSIDE their fixed bounds only, rightmost moat (.93,.24,.04,.29), small lower moat about(.54,.742,.16,.018); no unrelated rivers/pools. Absolutely NO upper-left lake. Add recognizable Sogamae soil ramparts and exposed earth cuts, NOT stone castle/modern reconstructed keep. Rich lush Japanese summer greenery, small bamboo clumps at outer edges, bare compacted soil, wooden fieldworks. Historical relation is siege outside outer defense line; no depiction of Toyotomi owning Hojo's castle. Scenic sculpted/painted arcade 3D matching reference, high oblique58degree view, no sky/horizon, no characters/UI/text/arrows or extra roads. Do not convert forks into loops, don't add connecting lanes or separate tower-raider trails.

generationPrompts.heightReadability: Improve the readability of HEIGHT in this existing arcade battlefield, while preserving its approved two-fork road layout and ALL gameplay ground coordinates. Same 1672x941 framing. The current image is too flat and aerial. Re-render at a LOWER oblique 38-degree view, with visually unmistakable lowland versus elevated plateau, no sky or horizon. Northwest (upper-left) ridge is tallest, friendly post at normalized(.16,.36) is a HIGH shoulder, next friendly post(.25,.52) is on a lower shoulder, and (.34,.70),(.42,.84) are LOWLAND. Keep all four road endpoints and road centerlines at exact source screen pixels for gameplay. Make the front/southeast face of the northwest ridge a broad CONTINUOUS exposed brown earth/rock escarpment, with its top lip clearly outlined by light and its bottom foot visibly shaded. This face belongs strictly below the upper terrace, never over the road or friendly post ground. First level vertical face approx two-to-three standing-soldier heights; second level about one-to-two soldier heights; lower field visibly broad and flat. Roads going toward the left high shoulder read as continuous UPHILL ramps with a visible berm-edge profile; keep slopes walkable, not stairways. Create clear distinction between light open HORIZONTAL terrace top and shadowed VERTICAL cliff faces; remove busy tiny shrub texture specifically on cliff faces so planar depth reads instantly. Do NOT make isolated decorative round hills, fake flat shadows, or stone masonry terraces. Use natural irregular exposed soil with few roots/rocks. The road forks, hostile small palisades/wooden town at right, two water moats and four blue friendly posts must remain at the same positions. No extra camps, roads, bridges, people, arrows, contours, numbers or labels. Arcade sculpted style as source, sunny summer with coherent oblique shadows, visually readable rather than photorealistic. DO NOT shrink the map or shift roads to make room for cliffs. Preserve flat placement pockets between roads, especially(.61,.56) and(.79,.46), and do not place cliffs or tall props there. This is a readability correction of the same map, not a new level layout.
